title: 第1章 天帝殿第2章 噬天帝诀
lines: 手臂粗的铁链，把一个少年死死捆缚，动弹不得。
现在的他，已然沦为阶下囚。
长达半年的折磨，现在的他已经生命垂危。
眼皮仿佛千钧重，怎么也睁不开，费了一番力气才缓缓睁开眼。
浑身血液仿佛被抽空了。
他知道自己的生命即将走到尽头。
眼中燃烧着无尽的恨意。
只是，当许辰看到两人之后，原本灰败的脸色，迅速染上一层病态般的潮红，整张脸扭曲而狰狞。
秦泰看着一脸狰狞的许辰，得意笑道：“许辰，你的命还真够贱的，半年了，竟然苟延残喘至今。”
“秦泰，为什么？为什么要这么做？十年前，你父亲带着你兄妹三人，被人追杀，负伤逃到清风城，是我收留了你们啊！
这些年，我当你是兄弟，何曾亏待过你？”
许辰艰难抬头，双眼赤红的盯着秦泰，问出了困扰他半年的问题。
秦泰大笑，“哈哈哈，你当我是兄弟？你若真当我是兄弟，为什么不把真火诀传给我？我先后求你三次了，三次啊，你都拒绝了。”
content_en:
Qingfeng City!
Xu family!
Dungeon!
Dark, damp, smelly.
Iron chains with thick arms bound a young man tightly, unable to move.
The young man’s name is Xu Chen.
The young master of the Xu family.
The number one genius in Qingfeng City.
But that's a thing of the past.
Now he has become a prisoner.
Life is worse than death.
After half a year of torture, he is now dying.
The eyelids seemed to be extremely heavy, and they could not be opened no matter how hard they were. It took a lot of effort to slowly open them.
"Hiss~"
Xu Chen gasped in pain.
My chest hurts terribly.
The blood in his body seemed to have been drained.
He knew his life was coming to an end.
But he was unwilling to do so.
Not willing to die like this.
There was endless hatred burning in his eyes.
"Crunch~"
The dungeon door slowly opened.
Two figures walked in.
One male and one female.
The man is handsome and the woman is pretty.
However, when Xu Chen saw the two of them, his originally gloomy face quickly turned a sickly flush, and his whole face became twisted and ferocious.
"Qin...Tai...Qin...Jing..."
The voice was hoarse and low.
Like a dying beast.
Qin Tai looked at Xu Chen with a ferocious look on his face, and said with a proud smile: "Xu Chen, your life is really worthless. It has been half a year, and you are still living."
"Qin Tai, why? Why do you do this? Ten years ago, your father and your three brothers and sisters were hunted down and injured and fled to Qingfeng City. It was I who took you in!
Over the years, I have treated you as a brother. How have I ever treated you badly? "
Xu Chen raised his head with difficulty, stared at Qin Tai with red eyes, and asked the question that had been bothering him for half a year.
"Brother?"
Qin Tai laughed, "Hahaha, do you think I am a brother? If you really think of me as a brother, why don't you pass on the True Fire Art to me? I have begged you three times, and you refused three times."
title_en: Chapter 1 Heavenly Emperor's Palace Chapter 2 Heaven-Devouring Emperor's Technique
